about: Shows the current workspace, project or environment in a control that opens a menu of the others. Pass `items` and the switcher renders the control and the menu, with `Switcher.Action` rows after a separator. It takes its shape from where it renders: a row in a sidebar, its mark alone once the sidebar closes to icons, one of a toolbar's controls with its name hidden when the toolbar is narrow, and one line on its own. The control is a menu trigger, so the roles, the keys and the positioning are the menu's.

alone.about: Anywhere else the switcher is one line: the mark, the name and the indicator. Each workspace has a page of its own, so each row is a link, and the current workspace is the page the reader is on. Open the menu from the keyboard and move through the rows with the arrow keys.
alone.title: On its own

composed.about: An environment switcher composed from the parts in a toolbar: `Switcher.Trigger` rendered through `Toolbar.Item`, so it is one of the row's arrow-key stops, and the menu's own rows. Its menu is as wide as its widest row.
composed.title: Composed from parts

palette.about: The eight palettes on the subtle look. The palette colours the look and the mark.
palette.title: Palettes

placement.about: The three placements, which `Switcher.Root` reads from the sidebar or the toolbar around it. In a sidebar the control fills the column and shows the detail under the name. In a toolbar and on its own it is one line as wide as its words.
placement.title: Placements

sidebar.about: At the head of a sidebar the switcher is a row as wide as the sidebar: the workspace's mark, its name over its plan, and the indicator. It takes the sidebar's size. Press the menu button to close the sidebar to icons: the row becomes the mark alone, square and in line with the rows under it, with the name in a tooltip and in its accessible name. The menu opens as wide as the row, with the current workspace checked and an action after a separator.
sidebar.title: In a sidebar

size.about: The three sizes in a sidebar. In an app shell the switcher takes the sidebar's size.
size.title: Sizes

title: Switcher

toolbar.about: In a toolbar the switcher is one of the row's controls at the toolbar's size, so the arrow keys reach it. The name is one line with no detail under it. At a phone's width the toolbar is narrow, the name is hidden visually, and the mark and the indicator remain.
toolbar.title: In a toolbar

variant.about: The button's six looks. `ghost`, the default, has no fill at rest and fills under the pointer. `outline` has the button's light edge.
variant.title: Looks
